name: Traveling bee hive
body:
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 206
Price 10 gp; Weight 10 lbs.
Category Animal Gear
Description
These straw baskets provide a portable home for bees. They are dome-shaped, with a hole in the top that a smaller woven basket covers as a cap. This hole allows for the harvesting of small amounts of honey without destroying the entire hive. Some farmers pay beekeepers to travel to their farms with the bees so the bees can pollinate their crops.

Destroying a traveling bee hive causes the bees to swarm in a 5-foot-radius cloud. A creature is blinded for as long as it remains in the cloud, and must succeed at a DC 12 Fortitude saving throw or become sickened for 1 minute. The sickened condition is a poison effect. The bees disperse after 1 minute or if the cloud is in the area of a damaging effect.
